conditions: A well-formed swizzle of a vector expression under the dated draft, with components in range and drawn from a single allowed component naming form.
limitations: The statement does not decide assignment to a const vector or the value category of another expression type. An out-of-range component and a mixed naming sequence are excluded.

triggers: An upstream correction, new dated draft, changed serving bytes, or conflicting scoped result.

statement: The November 10, 2026 HLSL working draft describes a well-formed vector swizzle as an lvalue only when its base is an lvalue and the component sequence contains no repetitions. Otherwise it describes the result as a prvalue.
